title: A Trip to the Beach
text:
Ana likes to travel. Last summer she took a train to the beach. The train was fast and clean. She looked out of the window and saw the sea.

At the station, she bought a ticket. The ticket cost ten euros. Then she waited for the train for twenty minutes. Ana was happy because the trip was short.

questions.text: How did Ana travel to the beach?
How much did the ticket cost?
How did Ana probably feel when she saw the sea?
What can we say about Ana's trip to the beach?

vocabulary.definition: a small paper or card that allows you to travel
a glass opening in the side of a train or house
an area of sand next to the sea

paragraph_translations: A Ana le gusta viajar. El verano pasado tomó un tren a la playa. El tren era rápido y limpio. Ella miró por la ventana y vio el mar.
En la estación, compró un billete. El billete costaba diez euros. Luego esperó el tren durante veinte minutos. Ana estaba contenta porque el viaje fue corto.
